# Delta Registry

> Pay-per-event regulatory, sanctions, procurement, and corporate-registry monitoring across 28 independently deployed Apify Actors, spanning 12 domains. Delta-classified output — a record unchanged since the last run is never re-delivered and never billed.

Every Actor bills strictly per delivered event: no subscriptions, no seat licenses, no minimum spend. Full pricing, delta-engine methodology, and BYOK disclosure live on the homepage.

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app): Fleet overview, live pricing, integration workbench, delta-engine documentation.
- [MCP server manifest](https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/mcp-server.json): server.json for connecting all 28 tools over MCP via Apify's hosted gateway (`https://mcp.apify.com?tools=...`, Streamable HTTP).
- [AI-agent tool schema manifest](https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/index.json): every Actor's OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/OpenAPI/LangChain/LlamaIndex/CrewAI/AG2 tool definitions.
- [Full documentation (llms-full.txt)](https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every Actor's input fields, defaults, and a runnable request example, in one file.

## B2B Data Enrichment

- [B2B Lead Enrichment Engine](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/actor-18-b2b-lead-magnet): Global. OpenStreetMap Overpass API + customer seed list (no Google Maps). $0.002 per lead. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/actor-18-b2b-lead-magnet/

## Sanctions & Trade Compliance

- [Maritime Sanctions Watchdog](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/actor-19-maritime-sanctions-monitor): Global (OFAC / UN). OFAC SDN vessel list x UN Security Council Consolidated List (by IMO number). $0.0005 per record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/actor-19-maritime-sanctions-monitor/

- [World Bank Procurement & Debarment Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/actor-20-mdb-procurement-monitor): Global (World Bank only — ADB / IDB excluded, see docs). World Bank Procurement Notices API + "Other Sanctions" debarred-firms table. $0.001 per notice record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/actor-20-mdb-procurement-monitor/

## Patent & IP Enforcement

- [Patent & IP Enforcement Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/actor-21-patent-ip-enforcement-monitor): US (USPTO, BYOK required) + optional EU (EPO, BYOK). USPTO PTAB proceedings (IPR/PGR/CBM/Derivation) + optional EPO opposition data. $0.002 per record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/actor-21-patent-ip-enforcement-monitor/
- [KIPRIS Patent & Trademark Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/kipris-patent-trademark-status-monitor): South Korea (KIPRIS Plus). KIPRIS Plus Open API — Korean patent & utility-model filings by applicant or application number. $0.02 per new filing or status change. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/kipris-patent-trademark-status-monitor/

FDA openFDA drug enforcement API + EMA DHPC safety-alert feed. $0.001 per delivered record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/actor-22-drug-safety-recalls-monitor/

ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 + FDA Orange Book patent/exclusivity data. $0.002 per record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/actor-24-clinical-trials-delta-engine/

## Government Registers & Procurement

- [Australian Government Grants Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/australia-grantconnect-monitor): Australia. GrantConnect (grants.gov.au) — 360,000+ record register, no official API. $0 pay per result (see live Store pricing). MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/australia-grantconnect-monitor/
- [Cordoba Government Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/cordoba-compras-monitor): Province of Cordoba, Argentina. Province of Cordoba's official public-procurement portal. $0 pay per result (see live Store pricing). MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/cordoba-compras-monitor/
- [Chile Official Gazette Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/diario-oficial-cl-monitor): Chile (national). Diario Oficial de Chile — laws, decrees, resolutions. $0.003 per record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/diario-oficial-cl-monitor/
- [Entre Rios Government Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/entrerios-compras-monitor): Province of Entre Rios, Argentina. - [Mendoza Government Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/mendoza-compras-monitor): Province of Mendoza, Argentina. COMPR.AR-based portal — Province of Mendoza. $0 pay per result (see live Store pricing). MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/mendoza-compras-monitor/
- [Buenos Aires Province Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/pba-tenders-monitor): Buenos Aires Province, Argentina (PBA — not CABA, not national). PBAC — official procurement portal of Buenos Aires Province. $0 pay per result (see live Store pricing). MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/pba-tenders-monitor/
- [Salta Government Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/salta-compras-monitor): Province of Salta, Argentina. - [Santa Fe Government Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/santafe-compras-monitor): Province of Santa Fe, Argentina. Province of Santa Fe portal — ministries and hospitals. $0.003 per full-detail record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/santafe-compras-monitor/
- [Tucuman Government Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/tucuman-compras-monitor): Province of Tucuman, Argentina. Province of Tucuman's official public-procurement portal. $0.003 per result. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/tucuman-compras-monitor/
- [UK HSE Enforcement Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/uk-hse-enforcement-monitor): United Kingdom. UK Health & Safety Executive — convictions and enforcement notices. $0.003 per detail-enriched record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/uk-hse-enforcement-monitor/
- [Lombardy Grants & Tenders Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/regione-lombardia-grants-registry-monitor): Lombardy, Italy. dati.lombardia.it Socrata SODA API — Anagrafica dei bandi regionali (~1,912 bandi). $0.02 per NEW_LISTING or STATUS_CHANGE record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/regione-lombardia-grants-registry-monitor/
- [EU TED Procurement Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/eu-ted-procurement-delta-monitor): European Union (all 27 member states, via TED). MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/eu-ted-procurement-delta-monitor/

## Corporate Registries

- [Singapore ACRA Registry Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/singapore-acra-registry-monitor): Singapore. data.gov.sg ACRA Collection 2 — full-field Singapore corporate register (~2.1M entities, UEN-indexed). $0.03 per NEW_LISTING or STATUS_CHANGE record. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/singapore-acra-registry-monitor/
- [UK Modern Slavery Statement Registry Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/uk-modern-slavery-statement-registry-monitor): United Kingdom. UK Modern Slavery Statement Registry (gov.uk) bulk CSV export — 34,000+ organisations, 23,500+ statements, Section 54 compliance-disclosure tracking. $0.02 per new statement. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/uk-modern-slavery-statement-registry-monitor/
- [UAE Corporate Registry Monitor](https://apify.com/stefano_seggio/uae-corporate-registry-monitor): United Arab Emirates (Dubai Mainland, ADGM, DIFC). Dubai Pulse (DED mainland trade-license register) + ADGM (Abu Dhabi Global Market) + DIFC public registers — bilingual Arabic/English entity-name normalization. $0.02 per new entity. MCP tool schemas: https://delta-registry-website.vercel.app/schemas/uae-corporate-registry-monitor/
